title: Software Installation Access Denied — Error 0x80070005
symptoms: Application not available in Software Center
error_codes: Error: This app has been blocked by your system administrator
Error: You do not have sufficient privileges to complete this installation
Error: Group Policy is blocking this application
diagnostic_questions: What software are you trying to install?
Are you trying to install from the Software Center or from an external source?
What is the exact error message you're seeing?
Is this software required for your job role?

diagnostic_tools.purpose: Check if user has software request permissions and what groups they belong to

resolution_steps.action: First, check if the software is available in the Company Portal / Software Center. Open Software Center from the Start menu and search for the application name.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Is the software listed in the Software Center?

resolution_steps.action: Click 'Install' on the application in Software Center. This will install it with the proper permissions without needing admin rights.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Did the installation complete successfully via Software Center?

resolution_steps.action: The software is not available in Software Center. You will need to submit a Software Request through the IT Service Portal. Go to serviceportal.corporate.com → Request Software → fill in the application name and business justification.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Were you able to submit the software request?

resolution_steps.action: If the Software Center installation failed with error 0x80070005, this is typically caused by a conflicting Group Policy. Let's try running the Software Center repair: Open Command Prompt as Admin and run: DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Did the DISM repair complete without errors?

escalation_criteria: If Software Center is not available, DISM fails, or if the user needs software not in the catalog
